label: Gatterer 1766 Abriß: Quellen der Wappenkunde placed before formal heraldic technique

features.value: Quellen der Wappenkunde begins at p. 7 after Erklärung und Eintheilung der Wappen and before the main formal sections

label: Gatterer heraldic sources divided into first and second rank

features.value: first rank: Wappen- und Adelsbriefe; Siegel; Münzen
second rank: Denkmäler; Lehenbriefe; Geschichtsschreiber; Turnierbeschreibungen; Familien-/Stammbücher and ceremonial descriptions; Wappensammlungen
secondary transcription reports copying error as a rationale for privileging the first group

Heraldikai lexikon/Történeti források, summary of Gatterer's first- and second-rank heraldic sources

label: Hefner 1861 explicitly contests Gatterer's hierarchy of heraldic sources

features.value: difference from Gatterer's school framed as different assessment of kinds and value of heraldic sources
objects to treating Wappen- und Adelsbriefe as the foremost source without an age limit; later charters require stronger criticism
source value varies historically rather than remaining fixed by genre
